label.en: TROPOMI SO₂ column, mean within 15 km
label.ja: TROPOMI SO₂カラム量(15 km圏平均)

note.en: Column amount on the day's clear pixels, not an emission rate (flux). Coverage = share of the ring with a valid pixel.
note.ja: その日の有効画素でのカラム量で、放出率(フラックス)ではない。被覆率=有効画素のある範囲の割合。

label.en: TROPOMI SO₂ mass on clear pixels within 15 km
label.ja: TROPOMI SO₂量(15 km圏の有効画素)

note.en: A lower bound when coverage is partial: cloudy pixels add nothing.
note.ja: 被覆率が低い日は下限値(雲の画素は加算されない)。

label.en: TROPOMI SO₂ column, mean within the 50 km box
label.ja: TROPOMI SO₂カラム量(50 km範囲平均)

label.en: Rain, satellite estimate (GPM IMERG Final), mean within 15 km
label.ja: 雨量の衛星推定(GPM IMERG Final)、15 km圏平均

note.en: A box average on a 0.1° grid (about 11 km), not a rain gauge; UTC days; Final run only, so the series ends months before today (the Final run's own delay). Shown beside lahar dates for context, never as a threshold.
note.ja: 0.1°格子(約11 km)の範囲平均で、雨量計ではない。UTC日。Final版のみのため、数か月前で終わる(Final版の遅れ)。ラハールの日付の参考として示すもので、基準値ではない。

label.en: MODIS (Terra) max fire radiative power within 15 km

note.en: Thermal anomalies include vegetation fires; a detection is not proof of volcanic heat.
note.ja: 熱異常には植生火災も含まれ、検知が火山の熱を意味するとは限らない。

label.en: VIIRS (S-NPP) max fire radiative power within 15 km

note.en: Thermal anomalies include vegetation fires; a detection is not proof of volcanic heat.
note.ja: 熱異常には植生火災も含まれ、検知が火山の熱を意味するとは限らない。

label.en: FIRMS MODIS fire detections within 15 km
label.ja: FIRMS MODIS 熱異常検知(15 km圏)

note.en: Thermal anomalies include vegetation fires; a detection is not proof of volcanic heat.
note.ja: 熱異常には植生火災も含まれ、検知が火山の熱を意味するとは限らない。

note.en: NOAA-20 VIIRS, its own series: not joined to the S-NPP record, whose deliveries end on 2026-11-02. Detections include vegetation fires; 'flagged volcanic' counts FIRMS type 1 (active volcano). Days without a flagged count are near-real-time (provisional) detections, which carry no type flag.
note.ja: NOAA-20 VIIRSの独立した系列で、S-NPPの記録とは接続しない(S-NPPの配信は2026-11-02に終了)。熱異常には植生火災も含まれる。「火山フラグ」はFIRMS type 1(活火山)の件数。火山フラグの件数がない日は準リアルタイム(暫定)の検知で、typeフラグがない。

note.en: Global network: small local volcanic earthquakes are below its detection threshold; PHIVOLCS counts are in the bulletins.
note.ja: 全球観測網のため小さな火山性地震は検知されない。PHIVOLCSの回数は火山情報を参照。

note.en: Global network: small local volcanic earthquakes are below its detection threshold; PHIVOLCS counts are in the bulletins.
note.ja: 全球観測網のため小さな火山性地震は検知されない。PHIVOLCSの回数は火山情報を参照。

label.en: Ground motion along the satellite's line of sight, Sentinel-1 track 32 descending (COMET LiCSBAS)
label.ja: 衛星視線方向の地表変位(Sentinel-1 トラック32・南行軌道、COMET LiCSBAS)

note.en: Summit area (pixels within 2 km) minus COMET's reference area, relative to the first date. Positive = toward the satellite, negative = away; line-of-sight motion mixes vertical and east-west movement, so it is not uplift or subsidence by itself. los_std_mm is the spread of the summit pixels, not a formal error. Processed by COMET, not by Plumes. COMET LiCSBAS (COMET Volcano Portal, https://comet.nerc.ac.uk/comet-volcano-portal/), processed by COMET, not by Plumes; LiCSAR contains modified Copernicus Sentinel data 2014–2026. Changes made: reduced to a summit series and a mean velocity per frame. CC BY-NC 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-nc/4.0/)
note.ja: 山頂付近(2 km以内の画素)からCOMETの参照域を差し引いた値で、初回観測日を基準とする。正は衛星に近づく向き、負は遠ざかる向き。視線方向の変位は上下と東西の動きを含むため、それだけで隆起や沈降とは言えない。los_std_mm は山頂付近の画素のばらつきで、正式な誤差ではない。解析はCOMETによる(Plumesではない)。COMET LiCSBAS (COMET Volcano Portal, https://comet.nerc.ac.uk/comet-volcano-portal/), processed by COMET, not by Plumes; LiCSAR contains modified Copernicus Sentinel data 2014–2026. Changes made: reduced to a summit series and a mean velocity per frame. CC BY-NC 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-nc/4.0/)
